subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Researchers in a 2022 study wanted to determine the effectiveness of 15 different exercise programs for improving cardiovascular health.
• They measured the percentage improvement in VO2 max (the oxygen uptake rate, or OUR).
• The OUR was found to be approximately consistent across the 15 programs (an average of 12% improvement).
• They measured the number of hours per week required for each program (the time commitment rate, or TCR).
• High-intensity interval training required the second-lowest TCR (3.2 hours per week).
• Traditional marathon training required the fourteenth-highest TCR (11.8 hours per week).
prompt: The student wants to present an overview of the study's findings. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The 2022 study determined the oxygen uptake rate (OUR) of 15 exercise programs in percentage improvement of VO2 max.
choices.B: Though some of the exercise programs differed in weekly time requirements, all 15 produced cardiovascular improvements at roughly the same rate.
choices.C: Researchers found that cardiovascular improvement was achieved more efficiently with high-intensity interval training, at 3.2 hours per week, than with marathon training, at 11.8 hours per week.
choices.D: Marathon training required the fourteenth-highest time commitment, higher than that of interval training, which required the second-lowest; however, interval training had the lower oxygen uptake rate of the two.

explanation: Choice B is correct. It presents an overview: weekly time requirements varied across programs while cardiovascular improvement remained roughly constant across all 15 programs.
